# glinet_samba (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet Samba global settings. Share sections and account passwords are not managed by this resource.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `charset` (String) Unix character set.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `description` (String) Server description.
- `interfaces` (String) Serving interfaces; empty leaves the firmware value.
- `name` (String) NetBIOS name; empty leaves the firmware value.
- `workgroup` (String) SMB workgroup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
